$comment: Named views for screenshots and e2e specs (scripts/views.ts describes the fields; scripts/shots.ts and e2e/views.ts use them). A camera position places the camera there, the player staying at the spawn; none is the player's eyes.

views.name: spawn
views.notes: The player's eyes at the spawn, looking at the horizon: the frame-time view.

views.name: horizon-haze
views.notes: Ground near the horizon from the player's eyes, a phone-shaped window: the grey see-through grid on distant ground (playtest 2026-10-14).

views.name: high-1000-wide
views.notes: 1 km up looking down at 35°, a wide window and the owner's settings: the gaps seen from high up (playtest 2026-10-14).

views.name: disc
views.notes: The whole disc from the flight ceiling (24,000 km).

views.name: e2e-placed
views.notes: For e2e/views.spec.ts: a placed camera 300 m above the spawn with the coarsest LOD, so it settles quickly under software rendering, and the F3 overlay (?debug=1).
